title: Yaro Svyatykh: moodboard as globs of objects around a question node
note: A new way of mood boarding: images gather into globs (clusters with rounded corner brackets) around a node; here the node asks 'What do we need to think visually?' and a cluster of cuneiform tablets, manuscripts and artefacts grows around it, with a text output card summarising the images (early figurative painting, writing). Clicking an image zooms it fullscreen over a blurred canvas. Soft grey canvas, small orange dot control. By Yaro Svyatykh (Ambient Direction), posted 2026-11-09, 'Cuz it's fun.' 38 s clip with sound. Thumbnail is a frame from the clip.
